title: OpenGTM Plugin Index v1
description: A static, signable, mirror-friendly index of plugin releases. Serve it as index.json next to the .ogc bundles it lists; sign it by writing index.json.sig, a detached Ed25519 envelope over the exact bytes of index.json (same envelope format as plugin.yaml.sig, with manifest_sha256 holding the SHA-256 of those bytes). The Go client in apps/server/internal/plugin/index is the reference implementation. Clients ignore unknown fields so minor additions stay compatible; a breaking change bumps index_version. Rules a schema cannot express (no duplicate plugin or version, valid semantic versions across the document) are enforced by the client.

capabilities.description: Copied from the signed manifest; the installer refuses a bundle whose manifest disagrees.

url.description: Bundle location: an https URL, or a path relative to the index (so a directory is a complete mirror). Plain http is accepted for loopback only; a remote index cannot reference local files.

size.description: Size of the .ogc file in bytes; also bounds the download.

publisher.description: Display name; the client's trust store is authoritative for who a key belongs to.

signature.description: The bundle's own plugin.yaml.sig envelope, pinned here. Installation requires it to equal the signature inside the bundle, and the bundle's signature to verify against a trusted key.

certification.description: Informational; the host does not act on it.

yanked.description: Never chosen as latest; installable only by explicit name@version.
